output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minted, the balances of target are increased by mintedAmount, and totalSupply is also increased by mintedAmount. If mintedAmount is large, overflow can occur, and the owner's balance can be set to a very large value.
The transfer function has a wrong logic. It directly transfers the specified amount to the target without any check, which can be exploited to transfer funds to any attacker-controlled address.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When decreasing the balance of _from, the function uses '-=' which can overflow if _value is larger than the balance of _from, causing a locked funds issue.

The changeFree function allows the owner to set a new value for the free balance, which can be exploited to devalue the token, allowing the owner to acquire additional token balances from user accounts.
